newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's July inflation paced by food, drink rises.
newsitem.headline: Peru's July inflation paced by food, drink rises.

text.p: Peruvian food and drink prices rose 1.2 percent in July, more than any other sector of the economy, which showed 0.83 percent inflation overall, the government's statistics agency said Friday.
The sector with the least inflation was rent, fuel, electricity and water, where prices dropped 0.1 percent last month.

Among other sectors measured by the National Institute for Statistics and Information (INEI), furniture and domestic goods prices were up 0.7 percent, transport and communications prices rose 0.4 percent, clothes and shoes 0.4 percent, health services 0.3 percent, education and recreation 0.3 percent and other goods and services 0.5 percent
The institute said Peru's annualized inflation rate in the first seven months of 1997 was 8.89 percent.
